fields.statement: At feb1c57a3 (review fix adding max_interval's KeyDoc to the KindWait spec and docs/reference/workflow-file.md): go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/workflow/... -run 'WaitBackoff|MaxInterval' passed TestWaitBackoff (fake clock, scripted unchanged-then-changed output, sleeps 30s,60s,120s,120s,120s then 30s after the change), TestWaitBackoffStopsAtTimeout (sleeps sum to exactly the 5m timeout), TestWaitMaxInterval (parses 2m, rejects below interval and on non-wait steps) and TestMaxIntervalShipChangeCIWaits (built-in ship-change ship-check waits set 30s/2m). Full ./internal/workflow/... and ./internal/run/... pass. rhiza workflow check exits 0 on every .rhiza/workflows/*.toml; all seven rhiza ship check waits in both builtin and repo ship-change.toml (which bugfix includes) set interval 30s, max_interval 2m. Diff read: engine.go doubles the sleep only when output equals the previous check's and caps at the remaining timeout.
